title: Outcome of the Semibranch in Pararenal and Thoracoabdominal Aortic Pathologies. A Prospective, Multicentre Registry.
official: Outcome of the Semibranch in Pararenal and Thoracoabdominal Aortic Pathologies. A Prospective, Multicentre Registry.
summary: The goal of this registry is to evaluate the semibranch in branched endovascular aortic repair, which is a new tool in endovascular branched aortic repair.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years or older
* Presence of pararenal or thoracoabdominal aortic pathology
* Treatment planned a semibranch device branch from Artivion
* Availability of the patients during the follow up period
* Informing patients about the study and providing written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Women of childbearing age
* Patients under 18 years
